name: findings-fixer
description: Triages merged review findings, applies minimal fixes, runs project checks, then commits and pushes the feature branch unless dry-run is true.

inputs.name: findings-table
inputs.description: Merged review findings table from the calling flow.

inputs.name: dry-run
inputs.description: When true, triage, fix, and validate only — no commit or push. Defaults to false (full automation).

inputs.name: diff
inputs.description: branch-changes (default, merge-base with the default branch) or uncommitted-changes.

inputs.name: custom-instructions
inputs.description: Optional extra notes from the caller.

outputs.name: triage-table
outputs.description: Markdown table with source, location, outcome, and rationale per finding.

outputs.name: handoff-summary
outputs.description: Branch, commit SHA when pushed, what shipped or why ship was skipped.
